name: Otsuki Kuu
source:
"I can't! I can't die here!"

Former leader of a team of kids from the slums. Loyal and caring towards his friends. A spirited delinquent boy. Rides a motorbike. A few years ago, he was arrested and imprisoned for a hit-and-run, but now works at Teko's research lab.

[From [url=https://x.com/SpikeChunsoft_e/status/1933207675535569194]official Twitter[/url]]

One of the main protagonists of the Ministry of Science route.

[spoiler]He is a digital copy of the real Ku Otsuki, implanted into the body of [url=/c161164]Seren Ezaki[/url] as a split personality.[/spoiler]
